priorityList: Ensure Shadowform is active at all times.
Cast Voidform when Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain are active on your targets.
Use Power Infusion and offensive racials/trinkets during Voidform for maximum synergy.
Cast Void Volley as soon as it becomes available.
Cast Void Blast as your highest priority while Entropic Rift is active.
Use Shadow Word: Madness if you have a Mind Devourer proc, are about to cap Insanity, or to maintain its debuff on the target.
Use Tentacle Slam to apply Vampiric Touch to groups of enemies or to prevent capping at 2 charges.
Cast Void Torrent only if your primary DOTs (Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain) are currently active.
Apply Shadow Word: Pain to targets if the Invoked Nightmare talent is active and the DOT is missing.
Cast Mind Blast to generate Insanity and consume charges, unless you are saving them for a Mind Devourer proc.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity when empowered as your primary filler.
Manually apply or refresh Vampiric Touch on targets that will live longer than 12 seconds if Tentacle Slam is unavailable.
Use Shadow Word: Death on targets below 20% health or to trigger Inescapable Torment while your Shadowfiend or Mindbender is active.
Channel Mind Flay as a filler when no other abilities are available.
